translations.web: Behold, they cried out, saying, “What do we have to do with you, Jesus, Son of God? Have you come here to torment us before the time?”
translations.bsb: “What do You want with us, Son of God?” they shouted. “Have You come here to torture us before the appointed time?”
translations.kjv: And, behold, they cried out, saying, What have we to do with thee, Jesus, thou Son of God? art thou come hither to torment us before the time?
translations.asv: And behold, they cried out, saying, What have we to do with thee, thou Son of God? art thou come hither to torment us before the time?
